idea-plugin.name: Quill
idea-plugin.description:
Inline code completion that streams as the model writes and checks itself against your project.

  • Ghost text from any OpenAI compatible server: local (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or hosted.
  • Project aware: enclosing scopes, members of the type before the dot, declarations in use, recent edits.
  • Verified: lines that use names the project does not define are fixed or held back before they appear.
  • Live latency in the status bar. Your API key stays in the IDE password safe.
